title: Kiritani Haruka — Behind The Surprise〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
That's a wrap!
Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Nice work!
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I still get so nervous during these shoots...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Some nerves are a good thing.
It helps you stay focused.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I don't know if that was the reason, but we did end a little sooner than expected.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We don't have any other appointments after this, so why don't we all go out for some food?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good idea. There's actually some really nice places to eat around here...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, come in!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Thank you for coming today, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
T-Today, we're on the scene!
We're the idol group that's been getting a lot of buzz on social media! MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This segment involves traveling to various places and taking a closer look at the lives of the locals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. And today, we get to be a part of the local elementary school's field trip!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A field trip...? What will we be doing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember this part, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for having us on for “Hey! Check Out This Town!” the other day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Collecting vegetables and making curry with everyone was very fun.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: I'm glad you all enjoyed it so much.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: I actually just heard that you're all in the building today. I've been meaning to ask you all about appearing again on our program.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You want us back?!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Yes, because we had more young viewers than usual tune in for your segment. They've been talking all about it on social media.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: It's not a particularly flashy program since it follows the lives of people in the countryside... But we've also been meaning to attract a younger demographic...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Then, we'll let you know once we've hashed out all the details!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to hearing from you.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Oh, also. You all have school during the week, yes?

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Would you prefer it that we schedule our meetings and the shoot on weekends, like we did last time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, that would help us quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, but... Depending on the date, we may be able to meet during the week.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Would you mind elaborating...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Ah, I see! You're switching to your school's credit-based course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once we're second years, we plan on working as much as we possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our hope is that we won't be as troublesome to book in the future, so please let us know anytime you'd like to make scheduling adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Ah, much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Then, I'll let everyone know that you're on board. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! They really want us back on!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so glad! I was hoping they'd ask us back since I enjoyed that shoot so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had fun too, but try to keep in mind that we're not going on vacation or anything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess going credit-based was the right choice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Definitely! And the producer seemed really happy when you said that we'll be easier to book in the future, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We don't move up a year for a little bit, but we're gonna work like there's no tomorrow after we go credit-based!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means we should probably start telling more people that our schedule's going to open up quite a bit when we do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good idea! We should make that clear to everyone we meet moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep... M-My tummy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's pack up and get something to eat.
